It was a pleasure to be there
Jan 2025 • Family
Our family had the most incredible dinner experience at this charming Turkish cuisine restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy, inviting atmosphere that immediately set the tone for an unforgettable meal.

The menu was a delightful blend of traditional Turkish dishes, and everything we tried was absolutely delicious. We started with a mezze platter that was beautifully presented and full of rich, vibrant flavors – the hummus, baba ganoush, and stuffed grape leaves were just the beginning of what turned out to be an amazing feast.

For the mains, we had the lamb kebabs, chicken shish, and a Turkish pide (similar to pizza but much more flavorful). Every dish was cooked to perfection; the lamb was tender and juicy, and the chicken was bursting with aromatic spices. The pide was crispy on the edges and wonderfully soft in the middle, topped with fresh ingredients that took it to the next level.

The service was outstanding. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made great recommendations based on our preferences. They also took the time to explain some of the dishes, which added a nice personal touch to the experience.

The desserts were a real highlight as well. The baklava was a sweet, flaky masterpiece, and the Turkish tea was the perfect ending to our meal.

All in all, this restaurant offers an authentic taste of Turkey right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. The combination of amazing food, exceptional service, and welcoming atmosphere makes it a must-visit for anyone craving Turkish cuisine. We’ll definitely be back with more family and friends! Highly recommend!

Plenty of menu options that reminded us of Istanbul AND a good selection of wines at reasonable prices. We chose the variety platter for 2 and matched it up with a French Rose. Ice bucket kept the wine cold and we ate the shredded lettuce with no after dinner stomach complications. So good we went back again and had a long chat with the owner who knows a lot about wine. Well done.
